title: Core Set 2020 Promos: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Within every angel is a spirit of light that will fight as long as there is darkness."
"As long as your courage remains, your life will not falter." —Sephara, Sky's Blade
"The realm of the gods opens before me!"
"The more secrets you have, the more easily you become my pawn."
"From a sea of infinite possibilities, our choices create the future." —Mu Yanling
"I have wept such a torrent as to scour the land clean." —Mu Yanling
"As one, nature lifts its voice to tell you this: 'No.'"
"When you are gone, will anyone remember your story?" —Unknown
"Let this serve as a reminder of your failure." —Exdratha, bog witch
It beckons silently, waiting in the darkness.
"I feel your pain. It's exquisite."
"With a single word, they were unmade." —Krinnea, *Siege of the Bone Spire*
"Now, *that's* a zombie!" —Modriss of Zargoth Fen
"One for you, one for me. What could be more fair?" —Kethis, the Hidden Hand
"You can sign, or you can spend your life imagining what might have been yours."
"Spread out, you idiots! Spread out!" —Marsden, party leader, last words
"I have calculated that a dragon in flight, in a single strafing run, can cover an area of—" —Thaedus the Clever, last words
"Stand still and try not to look like prey!" —Skerk Hobnett, wilderness guide
It's in the nature of fire to grow.
A strong leader means a growing pack.
"In times of need, the forest creates its own protectors." —Vivien Reid
It cares more about preserving the herd's territory than about preserving itself.
"When the forest walks, it's too late to run." —Horent, Khalni druid
"With each knight that rode out from the bone-white keep, the queen's soldiers felt their courage failing." —Krinnea, *Siege of the Bone Spire*
"The pen is mightier than the crown."
"The raging gale fans the flames of righteous wrath."
"Yarok grieves within the waste Of Bala Ged's corrupted land." —*Lament for Bala Ged*, stanza 1
There's no prepared like overprepared.
"Best bury them right. We don't want any gruesome encores." —Constable Trosk
"The world is already run by all manner of machines. One day, they'll remind us of that fact." —Sargis Haz, artificer
